note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere. Minted 2026-07-18 when make-doc converted from command species to procedural species (disable-model-invocation: true -> false) — closing the gap where check-doc, file-bug, feature, and issue already fenced 'NOT for drafting/other document types (make-doc)' but make-doc itself was invisible to auto-discovery. Positives drawn from the exact near-miss prompts doc-writing-rules, feature, and grill-the-ask's own suites already reserve for make-doc. Negatives are those siblings' own trigger territory, adversarially reused here. 2026-08-16 (issue #332): t11 added alongside the RDD type (mirrors t10's IDR case) — the description gained 'RDD' and the 'lock in the RDD' example phrase.
